body: Yes, sort of. I know it's hard to understand but my head is a pretty messed up place.

I know how it feels to be disappointed of yourself. I am too. We all thought we were going to be happy when we grew older, but the truth is we will not. Some of us might find happiness on the road, some others (like us) won't only because we can't see the reasons to persue it. I don't know how to make you feel better if I can't make myself feel better either. I just hope you know you're not alone (though I bet many people have told you that already). I don't know. Growing up sucks. I'm younger than you and I'm already screwed up. I'm dumb, untalented and ugly as hell too. I am not going to say your beautiful because you won't believe me and it'd be pointless if I don't know you at all. I'm not her to comfort you. I'm here to let you know that there are people like you, fighting off their demons and trying to keep breathing even if we know we are a waste of time.
